message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (per 9‑x‑13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Pasta** | Lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat Sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 3–4 |
| | Crushed tomatoes (canned or passata) | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | 1 tsp |
| | Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| | Dried oregano | 1 tsp |
| | Dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | ¼ tsp |
| | Fresh parsley or basil (optional) | 2 Tbsp, chopped |
| | Water or broth (if needed to thin sauce) | ½–1 cup |
| **Ricotta Mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan | ½ cup |
| | Fresh parsley, chopped | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt | ½ tsp |
| | Black pepper | ¼ tsp |
| **Mozzarella Layer** | Shredded mozzarella | 4 cups (about 400 g) |
| **Optional Extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, wilted) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | ½ cup |
| | Carrot, grated | ½ cup |
| | Zucchini, grated | ½ cup |

### Quick Prep Steps
1. **Cook the pasta** (if using regular sheets): boil until al dente, drain, and lay flat on a sheet of parchment to prevent sticking.
2. **Make the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, herbs, salt, pepper, and simmer 20–30 min.
3. **Prepare ricotta mixture**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper.
4. **Layer**: Start with a thin layer of sauce, then sheets, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and repeat. Finish with sauce and a generous sprinkle of mozzarella on top.
5. **Bake**: Cover with foil, bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min, then remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
